internalAdapterNotes.call: Existing production handler calls proxyLt(request) without adapter and fails closed. Host-only composition can inject LtInternalAdapter.fetch(request, context), wrapping an internal RPC entrypoint. No public fetch fallback.
internalAdapterNotes.request: Request URL https://lt.internal/api/lt/v1/operator/... retains pathname/query/method; JSON body bytes up to 65536; only Content-Type forwarded; redirect:error. Cookies, Authorization and browser actor/role/capability headers discarded.
internalAdapterNotes.context: Separate OperatorContext {actorId, role, requestId}, generated after requireRecentIdentity. requestId is proxy-generated. Rust derives capability from role. Internal entrypoint must authenticate actual binding reachability; context alone is not proof.
internalAdapterNotes.response: Adapter returns Response. Successful body/status returned with application/json and no-store, private; arbitrary upstream headers including Set-Cookie discarded. Error output reconstructed to known code, proxy requestId, bounded identifier-only fields; raw message/detail/headers not forwarded.
internalAdapterNotes.pendingErrorCode: Existing shared enum has no service-unavailable code. Current 503 fallback uses existing VALIDATION to retain ApiError schema shape; 501 uses INVALID_TRANSITION. Propose parent/foundation add SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE/NOT_IMPLEMENTED before integration.
